Author: Haselnussbomber
Name: XivReflex
Description:
NVIDIA Reflex Low Latency reduces system input lag by dynamically aligning the game's engine updates closer to the moment your GPU actually draws the frame on screen.

Requirements:

- NVIDIA GeForce 900 Series or newer
- NVIDIA Driver version 456.38 or newer
Punchline: Integrates NVIDIA Reflex Low Latency to reduce System Latency.
